```{r consolidatedRow, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# If utils.R defines compute_total_users and dashboard.R defines planitDarkGrey
# ensure they are sourced before this chunk or within the dashboard's setup chunk.
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "utils.R"))
source(here::here(".engine/Utilities", "dashboard.R"))

# Default color if planitDarkGrey is not available
if (!exists("planitDarkGrey")) planitDarkGrey <- "darkgrey"

# --- PART 1: AGGREGATE ALL METRICS (No Delta Calculations) ---

# 1. Compute total transactions and throughput together
# Assumes raw_data groups contain multiple runs, which we group by run_id
cons_metrics_df <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_tx = n(),
    duration_sec = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       units = "secs")),
    tps = if_else(duration_sec > 0, total_tx / duration_sec, 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Compute total users using the external utility function
# Assumes this function returns a DF with columns 'run_id' and 'total_users'
total_users_df <- compute_total_users(raw_data)

# 3. Join the metrics data frames together by run_id
# Ensure we have data for both transactions and users, ordered by run_id
final_metrics_df <- cons_metrics_df %>%
  left_join(total_users_df, by = "run_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(total_users) & !is.na(total_tx)) %>%
  arrange(run_id)

# --- PART 2: UNIFIED R template block ---

if (nrow(final_metrics_df) > 0) {

  # Build the consolidated template block containing all three value boxes
  # Note: Use triple single quotes to escape backticks in sprintf
  ticks <- "```"
  box_template <- paste0(
    # 1. Users Box (fa-users)
    "### %s Users\n\n",
    ticks, "{r, echo=FALSE}\n",
    "flexdashboard::valueBox(\n",
    "  value   = '%s',\n",
    "  caption = '%s',\n",
    "  icon    = 'fa-users',\n",
    "  color   = '%s'\n",
    ")\n",
    ticks, "\n\n",

    # 2. Total Transactions Box (fa-chart-bar)
    "### %s Total Transactions\n\n",
    ticks, "{r, echo=FALSE}\n",
    "flexdashboard::valueBox(\n",
    "  value   = '%s',\n",
    "  caption = '%s',\n",
    "  icon    = 'fa-chart-bar',\n",
    "  color   = '%s'\n",
    ")\n",
    ticks, "\n\n",

    # 3. Throughput Box (fa-tachometer-alt)
    "### %s Throughput\n\n",
    ticks, "{r, echo=FALSE}\n",
    "flexdashboard::valueBox(\n",
    "  value   = '%s',\n",
    "  caption = '%s',\n",
    "  icon    = 'fa-tachometer-alt',\n",
    "  color   = '%s'\n",
    ")\n",
    ticks, "\n"
  )

  # --- PART 3: Compile and Format Dynamic Row ---

  # Map all 12 placeholders sequentially for each row (run_id)
  src <- pmap_chr(final_metrics_df, function(run_id, total_users, total_tx, tps, ...) {

    # Formatted user display (with big marks)
    users_val <- format(total_users, big.mark = ",")
    users_caption <- sprintf("<strong>Total Virtual Users</strong>")

    # Formatted transaction display (with big marks)
    tx_val <- format(total_tx, big.mark = ",")
    tx_caption <- sprintf("<strong>Total Transactions</strong>")

    # Formatted throughput display (rounded to 2 decimal places with " /s" suffix)
    tps_val <- paste0(format(round(tps, 2), nsmall = 2), " /s")
    tps_caption <- sprintf("<strong>Throughput</strong>")

    # Order must match the combined template's placeholders exactly
    sprintf(box_template,
            run_id, users_val, users_caption, planitDarkGrey,
            run_id, tx_val, tx_caption, planitDarkGrey,
            run_id, tps_val, tps_caption, planitDarkGrey)
  })

  # Knit the consolidated string back into the R Markdown document quietely
  cat(knit(text = paste(src, collapse = "\n"), quiet = TRUE))

} else {
  htmltools::tags$div(style = "padding: 10px;", "No valid dashboard metrics available for consolidated display.")
}
